title: Much Nyasaye Iler Chutho
stanzas: Much Nyasaye, Iler chutho; Lerni mond' omeny chunya;
Kibedo koda Jakony, Mudhona duto norum.
Much Nyasaye, ahombi ngang', Mi chunya bedo maler;
Nyaka a ndalo mang'eny Kethruok oseloyoa.
Much Nyasaye, Jakony madier, Dak e chunya, miya kuwe;
Gol kethruok oko chutho, Changi chunya man gi tuo.
